About Maplewood

Maplewood Property Care is owned and run by Joe Lafleur out of Marshfield. Joe is the person who answers the phone, walks your property, and does the work, so the advice you get is the advice of the person holding the saw.

That advice is straightforward: what your trees and lawn actually need, in the right season, and a clear word when the right move is to wait. It is how Maplewood has earned its work across the South Shore, one yard and one referral at a time.
